The `ft6146_hw_init` function does:1. `BSP_TP_PowerUp()` - power up the touch controller
2. `BSP_TP_Reset(0)` - assert reset (low)
3. Wait 5ms4. `BSP_TP_Reset(1)` - deassert reset (high)
